summary: Round 2 verification of Hi Tours /afrika/aegypten page: full-bleed hero with overlay header, brand fonts/colors, URL-driven travel-style/sort filters, Ria Banerjee expert, Read more toggle, updated product cards, 'As seen in:' press logos. All 13 targeted scenarios pass on both 1440 desktop and 390 mobile emulation. 0 console errors. No horizontal overflow. Regression: /, /asien load cleanly. No source code was modified.

Clearing chip returns to /afrika/aegypten with 6 cards.

detailed_results.product_cards: PASS - 6 cards, 0 carousel dots, days ('11 days')+cities ('5 cities'), inclusions exactly 3 (hotels/activities/transfers). Price 'From ₹1,44,000 per person'. No 'stops' or 'p.p.' text anywhere.

detailed_results.brand_styling: PASS - Hero & Tours titles fontFamily contains 'Bricolage Grotesque'. Tours intro fontFamily contains 'Inter'. Hero CTA bg contains linear-gradient. No element uses rgb(0,109,68) old Tourlane green anywhere.
detailed_results.active_tab_underline: VISUAL PASS - Underline rendered via ::after/absolute element (not border-bottom); border-bottom-width=0px on all tab buttons. Orange underline visible under active 'About Egypt' tab in screenshot, matching Ember color. Note: border-bottom-color computed value on eg-tab-tours is not rgb(231,94,38) since underline is not implemented via border-bottom - this is a stylistic implementation detail, visual result is correct.
detailed_results.mobile_390: PASS - documentElement.scrollWidth=390 (no overflow). Hero copy visible over image; no eg-hero-copy-mobile element. Tabs strip overflow-x=auto with scrollWidth 867>clientWidth 390. Travel styles dropdown stays within viewport (left=102,right=382 within 390).
detailed_results.regression: PASS - / and /asien load with 0 console errors. Footer logo /hitours-logo.webp present.
